lastSample: 5. Macro & Rotation (Updated 11/25 to account for 5th Stigma)
Add Explosive Arrow as 5th Stigma as you get points.

After testing for 2 hours explosive arrow was a slight DPS gain over griffons arrow at 20.  The griffons damage remains the same over the course of damage, the only benefit would be the crits from the tick damage on vaizels, but no major changes over 2.5m tests enough to warrant the change to account for crit reduction.
